description: Defines a template class 'SingleStateQueue' implementing a non-blocking, single-element, single-reader/single-writer lock-free queue with nested 'Mutator' and 'Observer' classes for thread-safe state management.

classes.name: SingleStateQueue
classes.description: Template class implementing a lock-free, single-element state queue with nested Mutator and Observer classes.

classes.name: Shared
classes.description: Shared data structure holding the queue's state, including acknowledgment and sequence counters, and the value.

classes.name: Mutator
classes.description: Class providing methods to push new values into the queue and acknowledge reads.

classes.name: Observer
classes.description: Class providing methods to poll for new values and mark them as done.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Pushes a new value onto the queue, updating sequence counters atomically.

methods.name: ack
methods.description: Returns the status of the last push based on acknowledgment counters.

methods.name: ack (overloaded)
methods.description: Checks if a specific sequence number or later has been observed.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Returns the last value written to the queue.

methods.name: poll
methods.description: Checks if the value has changed since last poll and retrieves it if so.

methods.name: done
methods.description: Marks the current value as processed.
